label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is TP because the resolved sink value at L61-L62 is attacker-controlled data from user input, despite the presence of encodeForHTML(...). The XSS occurs because the encoded SQL string is still concatenated into an HTML response context. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is also TP because the resolved sink value at L56 is the user-provided parameter directly concatenated into the SQL query string.

evidence.note: SQL injection sink: 'sql' variable contains user input directly concatenated into query string
XSS sink: user input flows into HTML response context via concatenation, despite encodeForHTML() call
